name: EasyBrise
summary: US company formation for founders abroad: LLC or C-Corp filing in Wyoming or Delaware with EIN, registered agent and US address, plus optional tax and compliance plans.
best_for: founders outside the United States who want a Wyoming or Delaware LLC or C-Corp with an EIN, registered agent and US address handled in one first-year package, and optionally ongoing tax filing support
skip_if: you live in the US and only need the filing itself, where cheaper formation services exist; or your company will have little activity and the $1,499-a-year tax plan would cost more than the work it covers
honest_knock: The $295 covers year one; registered agent and address renew annually, listed standalone at $149 and $315 a year. Refunds stop once documents go to the state, government fees are not refundable after submission, and EasyBrise's own pages disagree on what Global Launch includes (EIN 'if included', address marked Pro+).

pricing.entry_price_terms: Global Launch · one-time setup fee, plus the state filing fee (Wyoming $104, Delaware $143 one-time)
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-15 on easybrise.com/pricing, its terms of service and refund policy; the terms say all fees are in US dollars) EasyBrise sells US company formation to founders abroad. Global Launch is $295 one-time plus the state fee, listed as $104 for Wyoming and $143 for Delaware, and includes formation, an EIN, the first year of registered agent and virtual business address, and lifetime access to a document vault. Tax & Compliance Pro is $1,499 a year and adds annual tax and state filing support with an annual CPA consultation; Elite is $2,499 a year and adds multi-member and C-Corp filing support with a quarterly CPA review. The pricing page warns that complex multi-state tax matters, audits, amended returns, payroll and sales-tax compliance may incur additional fees. Standalone services include a registered agent at $149 a year, a virtual address at $35 a month or $315 a year, annual report filing at $149 per filing plus the state fee, an ITIN application at $499, a 30-minute CPA consultation at $129 and bookkeeping from $99 to $399 a month. Registered agent and virtual address renew annually after the included period, and recurring services renew automatically unless cancelled.

compare_with.name: doola
compare_with.why: doola is in our dossiers too and aims at the same founders abroad: when we read it on 1 October 2026 its Starter plan was $297 a year plus state fees, covering formation, EIN, registered agent and a US address. EasyBrise charges $295 once for a similar first year, after which registered agent and address renew separately. Compare the second-year total of each before you choose.
